label: prf:jet-sw-tau-decomposition
title: Proof of the jet decomposition of the Archimedean realisation
html:
Proof. Proof of the jet decomposition of the Archimedean realisation

By prop:mi-sw-abelianisation, for each vertical degree n\geq 0 the Killing-norm projection of the surface-ordered multiplicative integral onto the n-jet component equals the prolonged Seiberg--Witten period, \lVert\mathrm{MI}\!\int_{\mathcal{S}_c}\rVert_{J^n} = \lvert a_D^{(n)}\rvert. The jet prolongation tower \{J^n E\}_{n\geq 0} is exhaustive — every vertical component of the connection lives at some finite jet degree — so the surface-ordered integral is the (convergent) sum of its jet components.

The Archimedean realisation \tau is additive on the graded pieces of the jet filtration (it is exact on the associated graded of the prolongation tower), so it commutes with the degree sum:

\tau\!\left(\mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{\mathcal{S}_c}\bigl(\nabla_A q,\,L\wedge F^+\bigr)\right)
= \sum_{n\geq 0}\tau\bigl(\text{$n$-jet component}\bigr)
= \sum_{n\geq 0} a_D^{(n)}.

Rewriting each period as its residue sum (prop:sw-period-residue-sum) gives the second equality. The Lean witness QOU.Brings.jet_sw_tau_decomposition packages the exhaustiveness and additivity as the structure hypothesis and extracts the graded-sum identity. \qquad\blacksquare
